per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall be portable and run on whatever servers we have in-house as long as the Java runtime can be installed there.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product will function alongside server software on any operating system where the Java runtime can be installed.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The product shall be packaged to deploy onto existing web or application servers (e.g., Tomcat, JBoss) and follow usual servlet standards without embedding exotic native dependencies.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product must make use of web/application server technology. Open source examples include Apache web server Tomcat and the JBoss application server.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall work against whatever DBMS the company runs (e.g., Postgres, Oracle, SQL Server) and must be able to connect over the network or to a local DB instance.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product must work with most database management systems (DBMS) on the market whether the DBMS is colocated with the product on the same machine or is located on a different machine on the computer network.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: Small UI actions shall feel instantaneous; typical UI button actions should complete within 5 seconds, and heavier tasks should not exceed 8 seconds without design changes or caching.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: The response shall be fast enough to avoid interrupting the user's flow of thought. 90% of tasks shall complete within 5 seconds. 98% of tasks shall complete within 8 seconds.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall support approximately 1,000 simultaneous requests at launch and be scalable to roughly 2,000 simultaneous requests by the next release.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product shall be capable of handling up to 1 000 concurrent requests. This number will increase to 2 000 by Release 2. The concurrency capacity must be able to handle peak scheduling times such as early morning and late afternoon hours.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The software component shall target 99.99% availability (four nines) excluding server-level failures.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'Aside from server failure the software product shall achieve 99.99% up time.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: Only company employees or explicitly approved external people shall be allowed to authenticate; anonymous access and public sign-ups shall be rejected. Authentication shall integrate with corporate identity providers (LDAP, SAML, etc.).
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product shall ensure that only company employees or external users with company-approved user IDs may have product access. 100% of all logons shall be by either company employees or external users with company-approved user IDs.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The application shall sanitize inputs, validate everything server-side, and assume attackers may attempt SQL injection or malformed payloads; it shall reject malicious input to prevent data corruption.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: The product shall prevent the input of malicious data. The product and/or adjacent hardware/software systems' data shall remain 100% uncorrupted each time malicious data is input into the product.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall guarantee that malicious input will not result in corrupted product data; data integrity shall be treated as sacrosanct.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: The product shall prevent the input of malicious data. The product and/or adjacent hardware/software systems' data shall remain 100% uncorrupted each time malicious data is input into the product.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: Exceptions and operational problems shall be captured in logs with enough context to reproduce issues, and aggregated exception data shall be transmittable to central support without leaking sensitive information.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product shall create an exception log of problems encountered within the product for transmission to our company for analysis and resolution.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: Logs and external reports shall not contain PII or full user content; sensitive fields must be scrubbed by default to comply with varying regional privacy laws.

The codebase shall follow standard design patterns and best practices, have good layering, clear interfaces, and test coverage so that a new maintenance developer can integrate a small feature within a couple of working days.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product must be designed using Design Patterns and coding best practices. 90% of maintenance software developers are able to integrate new functionality into the product with 2 working days.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The UI shall support localization and be brandable so different offices can apply their company look and feel.
The UI shall meet accessibility requirements, including screen reader support, keyboard navigation, and proper semantics.
The web UI shall work on modern, standards-compliant browsers, degrade gracefully where features aren't supported, and be responsive to support mobile access.
Operations shall be able to run the app in clustered setups for high availability, monitor key metrics, perform rolling upgrades, and use health endpoints for automated checks.
The application shall be stateless where feasible; session state shall be externalized and the application must document what needs to be backed up so instances can be replaced without data loss.
The app shall not make assumptions that prevent safe backups and restores; backups are handled at the DB and infrastructure layer but the application must be compatible with those processes.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product must work with most database management systems (DBMS) on the market whether the DBMS is colocated with the product on the same machine or is located on a different machine on the computer network.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: Telemetry and exception reports sent externally shall include stack traces, timestamps, environment details, and frequency, but must have sensitive fields scrubbed to avoid leaking PII.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product shall create an exception log of problems encountered within the product for transmission to our company for analysis and resolution.'
